page.overview:
Who is Giulia?

In one of the earlier incarnations of the movie, Pixar had a character named Giulia who was basically a double agent; she connected with Mater, and the two of them later went off and had their own adventures and met up again with the other characters at the end.thumb|left|Sketch of Giulia pt-br:Giulia Category:Cars 2 Characters Category:Unproduced
